subject: Request: Tenant-specific debug log winnowing + proof-of-delete & keystore rotation evidence
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novarad.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@novarad.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term retention for tenant 43B - proof-of-delete and keystore rotation evidence

Hi Karthik,

Quick ask from our legal/compliance team: for tenant ID 43B we need Redwood to hold debug/session traces for 90 days (instead of the standard 30d debug TTL) while we complete an internal investigation and regulatory filing. Requirements from our side:

- Logs should be retained for exactly 90 days then deleted; we need a signed proof-of-delete for the retained set (not just a log entry).
- Any PII in logs must be redacted at rest and in the delivered artifacts.
- We need documentation of keystore rotation and the KMS key IDs used for encryption during the retention window; ideally an HSM-signed note or audit entry.
- Evidence artifacts should map to CAIQ/SIG questions related to data lifecycle and key management.

Can Redwood provide a compliant pathway (mechanics + expected deliverables) and an estimate for producing the artifacts? If there are contract/addendum steps or a DocuSign we need to sign, flag that.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Senior Counsel, Novarad
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novarad.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term retention for tenant 43B - proof-of-delete and keystore rotation evidence

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask. Tagging Ben (sales lead) and Irene (security/compliance) to scope delivery. A few clarifying Qs so we scope the right artifacts:

1) Is the 90d requirement limited to debug/session traces only, or does it include request/response payload logs (which may contain higher-sensitivity PII)?
2) For redaction, do you require deterministic field-level redaction (e.g., mask emails/phones) or full tokenization/pseudonymization (so original values cannot be reconstructed)?
3) Do you need the proof-of-delete to include SHA256 manifests of the deleted files and the deletion job IDs, or is a signed statement with deletion job logs sufficient?

Tentatively our plan would be a tenant-scoped conditional retention rule (label-based winnowing) that routes tenant 43B debug logs to a short-lived secure bucket, apply automated PII masking, and schedule a deletion job at 90 days with a signed manifest. Irene — can you propose the technical deliverables and a realistic timeline? Ben — I'll need your help confirming commercial/addendum needs.

If convenient, I can set a 30-minute call later today.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novarad.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: short-term retention for tenant 43B - proof-of-delete and keystore rotation evidence

Karthik / Ben / Emily — outlining a proposed technical approach and deliverables below. I kept this at an operational level so your security and legal folks can validate specifics.

Scope assumptions (please confirm):
- Applies only to debug/session traces (engine debug, token-level debug, and ephemeral request traces). Excludes persistent user data exports and full request/response payloads unless Novarad confirms.
- PII redaction: we'll apply deterministic field masking for common identifiers (emails, phone numbers, SSNs) and pseudo-anonymize free text where feasible. If you require irrecoverable tokenization we need legal approval and additional config.

Planned deliverables (what we'll provide):
1) Winnowing rule config: tenant selector + routing to short-lived encrypted bucket. (attachment: winnowing-process-outline.md)
2) Keystore rotation notes: KMS key IDs in use during the window, rotation timestamps, and HSM audit entry references. (attachment: novarad_keystore_rotation_notes.pdf)
3) Proof-of-delete package:
   - Deletion job IDs and job run logs (timestamped).
   - SHA256 manifest of object names and hashes for the retained set prior to deletion (sample: sample_proof_of_delete_manifest.csv).
   - Signed deletion certificate: we will sign the manifest and job ID with a Redwood service signing key (key metadata included).
4) Redaction report: brief mapping of fields we redacted/pseudonymized and the regex/transform used.

Operational notes & timeline:
- Estimated work: 3 full business days to enact tenancy routing + masking and to run an end-to-end dry-run; 2 additional business days to produce signed artifacts after a successful dry-run (total approx 5 business days).
- Deliverables will be uploaded to a secure Share link and we can provide a signed ZIP with the manifest and deletion certificate.
- Contract: Because this is a tenant-scoped change to retention, Ben — commercial addendum / SOW? We will need either a one-time addendum or confirmation that existing terms permit this temporary retention change.

Security caveats:
- The signed manifest and deletion certificate are attestation-level artifacts. If Novarad needs a notarized/legal affidavit, we will coordinate through Legal and that will add time.
- If you require irrecoverable redaction or additional escrow of artifacts, that changes scope (and potentially region/data residency constraints).

Next steps:
- Emily: confirm scope (debug-only?) and redaction level.
- Ben: confirm contracting path (addendum vs. SOW).
- I can schedule the dry-run once scope and contract are agreed.

Attachments: winnowing-process-outline.md; novarad_keystore_rotation_notes.pdf; sample_proof_of_delete_manifest.csv

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novarad.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, compliance@novarad.com
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tenant-specific debug log winnowing + proof-of-delete & keystore rotation evidence

Thanks — that plan is acceptable in principle. A couple of confirmations before we proceed:

- Scope: confirm debug/session traces only (Novarad legal will not accept request/response payloads into the retained set). Confirmed.
- Redaction: deterministic field-level redaction is acceptable; tokenization is not required for this retention window.
- Deliverables: we need the signed SHA256 manifest, deletion job logs, the keystore rotation notes (KMS key IDs + rotation timestamps), and the redaction report.

We will sign a short addendum (DocuSign) that authorizes the temporary 90d retention for tenant 43B and clarifies liability/escrow. Ben — can you circulate the addendum and estimated price?

Can Redwood produce a sample proof-of-delete manifest for our legal team to review before the dry-run completes? If so please upload to the compliance portal link below (restricted access):
https://compliance.novarad.com/portal/request/9832

If everything looks good we can authorize the dry-run and start the clock.

Best,
Emily Torres
Senior Counsel, Novarad
Novarad Compliance Team

Attachments referenced: sample_proof_of_delete_manifest.csv
